_note: Phase 11.7: every coefficient used by lib/engine/eco/*.ts, with unit, source and whether a teammate has checked it. No magic numbers in code. All outputs are ESTIMATES and are labeled so in the UI. A home garden changes its own microclimate, water use, runoff and carbon at a small scale; it does not change regional weather.

gal_per_inch_sqft.unit: gal per inch over 1 sq ft

kc_turf.note: Warm-season turf (St. Augustine), FAO-56 style; UF/IFAS lists 0.6 to 0.9 by month

turf_root_in.note: Typical St. Augustine root zone in Florida sand

spray_efficiency.note: Share of sprinkler water that reaches the root zone

roof_collection_efficiency.note: Losses to first flush, splash and gutter overflow

first_flush_in.note: Rain below this does not reach the barrel

design_storm_in.note: Default storm for runoff and rain garden sizing; configurable

runoff_c.note: Rational-method values; Florida sandy soils sit at the low end for lawn and beds

rain_garden_porosity.note: Void space in amended sandy soil

nitrogen_lb_per_1000sqft_yr.unit: lb N per 1,000 sq ft per year
nitrogen_lb_per_1000sqft_yr.note: Typical home rates by feeding class; St. Augustine lawn 2 to 5 lb N in central Florida

co2_mature_kg_yr.unit: kg CO₂ per year at maturity
co2_mature_kg_yr.note: i-Tree style ballpark values for Florida urban trees; per species where listed, else per category. Herbaceous plants count 0

mowing_kg_co2_per_1000sqft_yr.unit: kg CO₂ per 1,000 sq ft per year
mowing_kg_co2_per_1000sqft_yr.note: Gas mower about 0.25 kg per mow per 1,000 sq ft × 30 mows a year in Florida (estimate)

kg_co2_per_mile.note: Typical passenger car, about 400 g per mile

compost_yield.unit: lb finished compost per lb scraps

compost_lb_per_ft3.note: Finished compost bulk density about 1,000 lb per yd³

rows_per_10ft_bed.note: A 4 ft wide bed counts as about 4 rows of 10 ft when converting the guide's 'yield per 10 ft of row'

shade_tiers_wall_hours_day.unit: shaded west+south wall-hours per summer afternoon
shade_tiers_wall_hours_day.note: Tiers only: energy savings are shown as low, medium or high, never in dollars, until a sourced coefficient is added

eco_score_weights.note: Team choice. Metrics that can't be computed (no house drawn, balconies) are left out and the rest re-weighted

grade_cutoffs.note: Team choice; tuned so a no-tree front yard can still earn an A with water and runoff swaps

carbon_target_kg10_per_100sqft.unit: kg CO₂ over 10 years per 100 sq ft
carbon_target_kg10_per_100sqft.note: Score scale: about one small shade tree per 300 sq ft earns full marks (team choice)

climate._note: Typical year for Tampa used by the water and rain barrel models: NOAA 1991-2020 monthly normals at TPA (rain) and Open-Meteo FAO-56 reference ET (ET0). Rain is spread over the month's usual number of rain days. Estimates, verified: false.
